newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli jets hit again in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets hit again in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes launched a second round of raids against suspected guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Wednesday, Lebanese security sources said.

They said two planes fired four air-to-surface rockets shortly after nightfall into Iqlim al-Toufah ridge, which is controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.

There was no immediate word on casualties in the raid that followed earlier air attacks in which Israeli planes rocketed Hizbollah targets in the Iqlim three times in the early morning. No casualties were reported in the earlier attack.
